reasoning: Based on the evidence, as of late February 2026, Russian forces have only secured footholds on the southeastern outskirts of Kostyantynivka after ~1.5 months of effort. Multiple sources indicate Russian command has only 2-3 spring months to capture both Kostyantynivka and Druzhkivka for their summer offensive plans. Ukrainian forces still hold key positions south of the city. The railroad station is in the central/western part of the city, which Russian forces have not yet reached. Given the slow pace of advance (~1km in 2.5 weeks), capturing the railroad station by June 30 appears unlikely but possible if Russian forces accelerate. The 4-month timeframe is tight given current progress.
